title: Digitalis Hiking Boots, Women's, US 6
description: The forest floor, three hours past the trailhead. From ten feet away it reads as a solid dark boot. Lean in and it's roses and moths all the way down. Acherontia doesn't ask you to choose. Fresh print may carry a faint scent on arrival. Airs out within 48 hours. Sizes: Women's US 6-12 · Half sizes available
